claims: Arslanbek Makhmudov is a Russian-Canadian professional heavyweight boxer.
Arslanbek Makhmudov has a 21-2-0 record as of April 2026.
Arslanbek Makhmudov has 19 wins by knockout as of April 2026.
Arslanbek Makhmudov's KO percentage is ~90.48% as of April 2026.
Arslanbek Makhmudov is known as the "Lion".
Arslanbek Makhmudov has a win over Carlos Takam.
Arslanbek Makhmudov has a win over David Allen.
Arslanbek Makhmudov's only defeats are against Agit Kabayel and Guido Vianello.
Arslanbek Makhmudov won vs. David Allen (UD-12) on Oct 11, 2025.
Arslanbek Makhmudov lost vs. Guido Vianello (TKO-8) on Aug 17, 2024.
Arslanbek Makhmudov won vs. Miljan Rovcanin (KO-2) on May 25, 2024.
Arslanbek Makhmudov lost vs. Agit Kabayel (TKO-4) on Dec 23, 2023.
